comments.content: Dangling reference: `strprintf(...)` returns a temporary `std::string`, and binding it to `std::string_view services` leaves `services` pointing to freed memory once the temporary is destroyed at the end of this statement. The subsequent use of `services` in the next `strprintf` reads freed memory (UB). Use `const std::string services{...}` instead of `std::string_view`.

The header already shows services when details are requested (via the `- services %s` suffix), and this block adds a 'Local services' line when details are NOT requested. This looks intentional, but note the naming/formatting inconsistency: `FormatServices` is used for the header while `ServicesList` is a separate near-duplicate helper. Consider reusing a single formatting helper to avoid divergence between the two representations.
